mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmFinalOrderDateViewPopKMList*/ SELECT MAX(CM.COM_NAME_LOC) AS BUYER_NAME , MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, MAX(A.ADD_DATE) AS ADD_DATE FROM ICOMPODT A , ICOMCMPY CM WHERE A.BUYER LIKE 'KRX%' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO||'00001' = #{st_buyer_item_no} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = CM.COM_CODE AND A.ITEM_QTY = NVL(A.GR_QTY,0) GROUP BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
